subject: Onshore evidence sprint: subprocessor ownership & KMS custody map
messages:
From: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@novacare.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@novacare.com
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: onshore subprocessor roster + KMS custody details

Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier. As part of NovaCare's SIG-lite and procurement review we need a scoped subprocessor roster that highlights:
- Which subprocessors are onshore (US) vs offshore
- Any KMS/HSM custody responsibilities (who holds keys, where to escalate)
- Whether any subprocessor has access to plaintext customer data or only encrypted blobs

Can you provide an initial snapshot and any artifacts (CAIQ responses, KMS provenance diagrams, SOC2 snapshot) you can share within five business days? We have an internal deadline for vendor gating on 6/02 and would like a mutual action plan if there are gaps.

Thanks,
Lisa Hart
Director, Procurement
NovaCare Health

--
Attachment: vendor-questionnaire-v2.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Lisa Hart <lisa.hart@novacare.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onshore subprocessor roster + KMS custody details

Lisa —

Appreciate the summary and the gating date. We'll run a focused 10-business-day evidence sprint and prioritize onshore residency and KMS custody details first. High-level plan:
1) Day 0–2: internal triage and extract subprocessor CSV (will attach roster + residency flags)
2) Day 3–5: map KMS custody paths and produce a provenance diagram
3) Day 6–10: package CAIQ/SIG artifacts, SOC2 snapshot, and a mutual action plan for any gaps

Deliverables we'll attach for the first drop: redwood-subproc-roster.csv (with residency & data access flags), kms-provenance-diagram.pdf, and a SOC2 snapshot. If you need an accelerated delivery for the onshore-only items we can prioritize those for a 3-business-day delivery — please confirm.

I'll coordinate with Marissa (Security) and Jonas (Infra) on the technical certs. Proposed next step: 30-minute sync on Wednesday 5/27 to confirm priority subprocessors and sign the MAP.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-subproc-roster.csv (attachment stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-26T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onshore subprocessor roster + KMS custody details

Ben / Jonas —

A couple technical notes before we send the outbound package to NovaCare:
- We'll mark 'onshore' any provider with primary data handling in US regions (us-east/us-west). For clarity, include both residency and SLA residency guarantees where available.
- KMS custody: Redwood uses customer-specific envelope keys managed in our KMS for Private deployments; for Hosted we retain wrapped keys with optional HSM-backed root. We should show a simple custody table (Redwood KMS, Cloud KMS of partner X, HSM vendor) and call out "no direct plaintext access" for cache-only services. For a handful of partners (LogStoreX) we do allow transient plaintext for ingestion; call that out specifically.
- CAIQ/SIG: we'll include a redacted CAIQ and our SIG-lite responses that map directly to the procurement questions.

I'm attaching a quick diagram and the SOC2 snapshot for context. Jonas — can you pull the most recent transient-access audit for LogStoreX and annotate dates of access? We'll likely need that in the MAP.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-provenance-diagram.pdf (attachment stub), SOC2-snapshot-2027Q1.pdf (attachment stub)
